name: GC Controller Test
author: corenting
description_short: A simple homebrew to test your GameCube controllers.
description_long: GC Controller Test displays live input from up to four connected GameCube controllers. It reports every digital button, analog L/R trigger values, and the X/Y positions and directions of both the main stick and C-stick. Press a button on any port to switch the active controller, and use A+B to verify the rumble motor.
